tex_content.html:
Lemma
[A one-sided jump estimate] ↗ thm:lax-oleinik-formula 1. ch3:3.4-lem-1\group Conservation Laws

There is $C$ such that the Lax--Oleinik solution satisfies \[ u(x+z,t)-u(x,t)\le \frac Ct z\qquad (z>0). \]

Proof

\sketch Restrict minimizers to a bounded velocity interval, so $G$ is Lipschitz there. Monotonicity of $y(x,t)$ and $G$ then give

\[ G((x-y(x,t))/t)\ge G((x+z-y(x+z,t))/t)-\operatorname {Lip}(G)z/t. \]

This is the claimed estimate.

□
